en.text:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a kill grants 'Bewildering Burst' for #e${6+#d} seconds.

While Bewildering Burst is active, your next Direct Hit spawns a <kinetic/>Kinetic explosive above the target that detonates after a 0.85 second delay. The detonation deals <pve 10 /> <pvp [4] /> damage and Disorients enemies within a 10 meter radius for <pve 3.5 /> #e<pvp [${1+#f}] /> seconds. 

enhanced (
var d = 1
var f = 0.25
#e Buff lasts for one additional second. Disorient lasts longer.
)
